name: evaluate_vram_skill
description: Evaluate whether a proposed experiment configuration fits within available GPU VRAM (80% safety limit). Must be called before training to prevent OOM crashes.

model_type.description: The model architecture to evaluate (any model in MODEL_REGISTRY).

model_config.description: Model configuration dict (same as passed to training_skill).

train_config.description: Training configuration dict — batch_size is the key field.

loss_config.description: Loss configuration dict — loss_type determines extra memory (focal needs one_hot).
